scope: Unlimited profile adapter extension. Historical painter ancestry is reconstructed only after neighboring selector and synthetic native equivalence controls; per-set values remain independently validated data.

lines:
material === 'L'
      ? set === 'chr' && face.name === 'Safe Haven'
        ? 'L-dark'
        : (set === 'chr' && face.name === 'City of Brass') ||
            (set === '4ed' && face.name === 'Oasis')
          ? 'L-gold'
          : 'L-red'
      : material;
? `© ${set === 'fem' ? '1994' : '1995'} Wizards of the Coast, Inc. All rights reserved.`
